patch_application.line_endings: Patches preserve archived source bytes, including CRLF where present. Apply directly to the working tree; do not normalize or re-save patch files.

source_tree_digest.format: For every packaged source-tree file sorted by POSIX relative path, concatenate its lowercase SHA-256, two spaces, relative path, and LF; hash the resulting bytes. Git metadata and runtime/build outputs are excluded.

license.notice: TensorFold copyright 2026 TensorFold contributors. Pre-0.6 code retains the MIT notice; third-party terms remain applicable.

fanout.source_version: Archived retained DFlash head-pruning source; three changes relative to the pinned upstream commit.

provenance.method: Applied the archived retained patch to the clean pinned upstream, then restored exact bytes of all three archived final source files. Those files also match the separate baseline source archive.
limitations: Historical notes state that final test-discovery-only source changes followed the measured executable build. Source archive identity is verified; bit-for-bit reproduction of the measured executable has not been established.
Later quantization, profiling, graph, and shared-context changes are not part of this historical variant.

shared-context.display_name: Shared GPU context with synchronized branches (thinking low)
shared-context.source_version: Final synchronized source, including all inherited local native changes and previously untracked files.

provenance.method: Reconstructed inherited source from the pinned upstream, its tracked-source patch, and twelve previously untracked files. All 11,222 inherited snapshot hashes matched. Applied the synchronized delta and preserved raw final source bytes; all 46 final delta hashes matched. The independent patch includes 86 modified or new upstream files.
limitations: The archived synchronized semantic patch normalizes line endings in twenty files; this complete patch preserves their final recorded raw bytes.
A fresh native rebuild and GPU execution have not been performed during packaging. The historical executable hash identifies prior evidence only.

experimental12.source_version: Cumulative shared-context, 16-lane admission, compact VRAM state, shared-width calibration and short-tail dispatch patches. Default launcher uses 12 lanes.

provenance.method: Compare every qualified source file with the pinned upstream, create a cumulative patch, apply it to a separate clean checkout, and verify every resulting file hash. The qualified executable was built and GPU-tested before packaging.
limitations: The published patch reconstructs the qualified source tree exactly. A fresh executable build and GPU benchmark were not repeated during packaging; bit-for-bit binary reproduction is not claimed.
